name: Strata Senior USDe
oneLiner: srUSDe is Strata's senior tranche over a USDe yield strategy; the junior tranche absorbs first-loss while exits depend on tranche liquidity, not 1:1 redemption.

controls.label: srUSDe ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: Ethereum RPC asset() returned USDe 0x4c9EDD5852cd905f086C759E8383e09bff1E68B3; parent USDe has reviewed mintAuthority. Re-verified 2026-07-20 at block 25570877: EIP-1967 impl 0xe894055ca1c73648927e225f3ca38ed48e30210b, admin ProxyAdmin 0x30a17d6bcbdbf1579d6fbba453acf776d01fbb50, whose owner() is TimelockController 0xb2a3cf69c97afd4de7882e5fee120e4efc77b706 (getMinDelay() = 172800 s). The wrapper only does deposit/share accounting; it does not mint base USDe.

review.evidence: Re-verified 2026-07-20 at Ethereum block 25570877: the srUSDe wrapper 0x3d7d6fdf07ee548b939a80edbc9b2256d0cdc003 is a transparent proxy (EIP-1967 impl 0xe894055ca1c73648927e225f3ca38ed48e30210b, admin ProxyAdmin 0x30a17d6bcbdbf1579d6fbba453acf776d01fbb50); ProxyAdmin.owner() returned 0xb2a3cf69c97afd4de7882e5fee120e4efc77b706, a TimelockController-style contract (6726 bytes; getMinDelay() = 172800 seconds; getRoleMember enumeration reverts). RoleGranted event history from deployment block 23049699 to 25570823 (zero RoleRevoked events) plus a confirming hasRole() read resolve the full governance chain: PROPOSER_ROLE is held solely by Safe 0xa27ca9292268ee0f0258b749f1d5740c9bb68b50 (171-byte Safe proxy, getThreshold() = 3, getOwners() = 0x791fb9322132e7bd7a84d233371aa8c21aad5a510, 0x296400d87be5cfb63c5025904cd006ebb23d15d5, 0xd796e125af489cffb4a766df4ded9272e458249c, 0x206cff3df3c6af6f03eeb86fba2c3dfa420b4ac7 — a 3-of-4 Strata Safe); CANCELLER_ROLE is held by the same Safe plus the 23-byte contract 0x277d26a45add5775f21256159f089769892cea5b; EXECUTOR_ROLE was granted to the zero address (permissionless execution after the two-day delay); DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is held only by the timelock itself. The previously unresolved upgrade-governance question is therefore resolved: wrapper upgrades require a 2-day timelock proposed by the 3-of-4 Strata Safe. Wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting; durable USDe mint authority is inherited from the reviewed Ethena controls.
review.reviewer: SONG-1 mint-control evidence review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-8 (lead usdy-ondo-finance)

collateral: Senior tranche (ERC-4626 meta-vault) over Strata's CDO-style risk-tranched strategy that stakes USDe into Ethena sUSDe; the junior tranche (jrUSDe) provides first-loss capital and is paid a dynamic risk premium, giving senior holders principal protection and a benchmark-rate yield floor with uncapped sUSDe upside, while a junior-exhausting insolvency event can still impair senior principal
pegMechanism: srUSDe targets a stable senior NAV backed by USDe strategy collateral and junior-tranche subordination; exits depend on Strata tranche liquidity and settlement rules rather than a simple 1:1 stablecoin redemption

oracleRisk.summary: srUSDe is a senior ERC-4626 tranche over Strata's USDe strategy and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or token-level liquidation oracle. Junior capital absorbs first loss, while underlying USDe and sUSDe risks remain inherited dependencies.

branchApplicability.rationale: Strata documents srUSDe and jrUSDe as risk-tranched vaults with ERC-4626 deposits and withdrawals, where the junior tranche provides first-loss protection for the senior tranche. This is a shared strategy and redemption path, not borrower-specific collateralized debt, so there are no srUSDe collateral-market or liquidation branches to inventory.

reserveReview.rationale: The current live reserve capture is a single 100% senior-tranche USDe vault-share exposure. Strata documents srUSDe as an ERC-4626 senior tranche over the Ethena USDe/sUSDe strategy, with USDe withdrawals subject to a seven-day cooldown; the existing tracked dependency preserves the upstream USDe failure domain.
